coverage: HTTP 403/429/503 bounded retries and one browser fallback
browser success recovers source and freezes DOM cache
missing browser and corrupt cache are not environmental exclusions
HTTP 200 challenge with help link never enters fact evidence
actual engine builds full DAG before denied root and preserves costs
paired skips preserve identical denominators and continue later questions
all excluded produces null accuracy, zero judge failures
exclusion in either arm excludes same question in both arms

exclusion_scope: Only dataset-provided root-page unavailability. Intermediate-link errors continue other frontiers and do not exclude questions. Model/protocol/parse/config/cache/disk failures remain scored failures.
result_reporting: all-planned denominator accuracy bounds with exclusions counted as failures

previous_live_preflight.note: Prior v4 archive preflight only; not rerun for access v1. Not a new prediction/accuracy claim.

remote_linux_execution: Not run here. User curl probe reached some dataset sites and observed 403/429 on others; actual Chromium target access remains to be tested.
known_limits: Access exclusions yield a locally accessible common subset, not official full-set benchmark accuracy.
Ordinary browser fallback cannot guarantee access or solve CAPTCHAs.
Intermediate-link failures may still cause unanswered questions, retained as failures.
Automated challenge detection uses explicit markers; website changes remain possible.

previous_installed_payload_tests_before_.note: 125 hashed payload files installed into a clean target; isolated Playwright and Chromium from previous installation reused. Includes real browser denial and JS-rendering tests.

current_web_tests.scope: All current Web tests, including four new PersonaMem stopped-state gate cases and real browser tests. Full core regression was not repeated for this gate-only change.
